item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E001","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"On August 9, 2023, the article reported that 33 people had been released from remand detention, including detainees held on terrorism and false-news charges; reported explanations included opposition and civil-society pressure, efforts to contain dissent ahead of economic difficulties and the 2024 election, and diplomatic pressure.","notes":["The excerpt says the article date was August 9 and the releases occurred on Monday, but does not explicitly state August 7.","The competing explanations are attributed to interviewees or sources, not established as fact."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E002","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The article reported that the United States withheld or did not provide US$75 million of the US$1.3 billion in annual military aid to Egypt over human-rights concerns, and that the European Parliament took official steps to object to rights violations in Egypt.","notes":["The excerpt does not explicitly connect the European Parliament's objections to political imprisonment."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E003","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Moaz al-Sharqawy was arrested at home on May 11, 2023; his whereabouts were unclear for 23 days; he was then ordered held for 15 days pending investigation into terrorism-related charges. He told investigators that National Security Agency officers took him to an unknown location and that he was assaulted while blindfolded.","notes":["The excerpt reports that his whereabouts were unclear, but does not itself characterize the disappearance as forced."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E013","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E014","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E015","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E016","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E017","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E018","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E019","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E020","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E021","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The approved measures included a ten-working-day limit for required approvals, expanded golden-license eligibility, a proposed study of greater regulator independence, and approval of a draft decision to create a cabinet unit whose decisions would be binding regarding restructuring state-owned companies, with reports to the President and cabinet every three months.","notes":["The excerpt describes several items as draft decisions, assignments, or studies rather than completed institutional changes."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E022","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In June 2023, the report described dissent as suppressed, media as muzzled, and the justice system as difficult to navigate; rights groups cited 562 blocked websites, no opposition newspaper, effectively no demonstrations, and a state of fear involving arrest and open-ended detention.","notes":["The supplied excerpt does not establish that AFP reported the entire set of claims; it attributes specific statements to rights activists and groups."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0006-E023","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Rights monitors reported that at least 16 inmates had died in Egyptian verified.","notes":["The excerpt says 'so far this year' in a June report, not explicitly 'during the first half of
